cards.text: The LORD of Hosts just called out the priests who despise His name (Malachi 1:6). Now Malachi, the one this message came through (Malachi 1:1), speaks and includes himself. He opens with two questions: "Do we not all have one Father? Did not one God create us?"

cards.question: Same Father, same God. Yet Malachi asks why we do something to one another. What is it?

cards.text: Breaking faith with one another, Malachi says, profanes the covenant of their fathers. Then he says it plainly: Judah has broken faith, and an abomination has been committed in Israel and in Jerusalem.

cards.question: Malachi says Judah has profaned the LORD's beloved sanctuary. How?

answers.text: By marrying the daughter of a foreign god
By bowing down to the idol of a foreign god
By burning incense to the image of a foreign god

cards.text: For the man who does this, Malachi says, may the LORD cut off from the tents of Jacob everyone who is awake and aware.

cards.question: Malachi says the man who marries the daughter of a foreign god is safe, as long as he brings an offering to the LORD of Hosts.

cards.text: Then Malachi says, "And this is another thing you do: You cover the altar of the LORD with tears, with weeping and groaning…"

cards.question: The people of Judah are covering the LORD's altar with weeping and groaning. Why?

answers.text: The LORD no longer receives their offerings gladly
Their enemies have broken down the city walls
The rain has stopped falling on their fields

cards.text: Yet the people ask, "Why?" Friend, that's me pulling raw dough out of a cold oven yelling "WHY?!" when I never even turned it on.
Malachi's answer points to the wife of their youth, the one they've broken faith with. I think this one hurts.

cards.question: Malachi answers their "Why?" by saying the LORD has been a witness between each of them and the wife of his youth.
They have broken faith with the wife of their youth. Malachi says she is a man's companion and his wife by ___.

cards.text: Then Malachi asks, "Has not the LORD made them one, having a portion of the Spirit? And why one?"

cards.question: Malachi asks why the LORD made them one. He answers that it's because the LORD seeks ___ offspring.
Malachi tells the men to guard themselves in their spirit and not break faith with the wife of their youth.

cards.text: Then the LORD, the God of Israel, speaks for Himself, and friend, I turn the mixer OFF for this one.

cards.question: The LORD, the God of Israel, names one thing He hates. What is it?

cards.text: The LORD of Hosts says the man who divorces his wife covers his garment with violence. Then comes that line again: guard yourselves in your spirit and do not break faith.
